en_title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Actors Break Years of Silence With New Joint Statement
cn_title: 《GTA6》Jason与Lucia的演员打破多年沉默，发表联合声明
opus_summary: 《GTA6》现已正式推出，完整演员阵容也已公布。饰演Jason的Dylan Rourke和饰演Lucia的Manni L. Perez在Instagram发表联合声明，回顾参与游戏制作的经历，并向制作人员致敬。Perez本周早些时候获得The Game Awards最佳表演提名时，其角色已得到确认。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6's lead actors, Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez , have broken their multi-year streak of silence about starring in the game.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》的主演Dylan Rourke和Manni L. Perez打破了他们对出演这款游戏一事长达数年的沉默。

paragraphs.en: With GTA 6 officially being out now, the game's full cast has officially been announced . Rockstar kept the actors under a veil of secrecy for the better part of a decade, though some fans were able to figure out who they were thanks to some sleuthing. Still, despite this, the actors maintained strong poker faces, and it's honestly commendable how well they kept their roles under wraps. To celebrate the game's launch, Rourke (who plays Jason) and Perez (who plays Lucia) released a joint statement on their Instagram accounts about their experience working on the game.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《GTA6》正式发售，游戏的完整演员阵容也已正式公布。在近十年的大部分时间里，Rockstar一直对演员身份严格保密，不过一些粉丝通过一番调查找出了他们的身份。尽管如此，演员们依然守口如瓶，他们能将自己的角色保密得如此之好，确实值得称赞。为庆祝游戏发售，Rourke（饰演Jason）和Perez（饰演Lucia）在各自的Instagram账号上发表了一份联合声明，谈及参与游戏制作的经历。

paragraphs.en: "Years witnessing the hardest working and most skilled artisans game making has to offer," reads their statement. "We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower. So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See y’all in Leonida."
paragraphs.cn: 他们的声明写道：「多年来，我们见证了游戏制作领域最勤奋、技艺最精湛的匠人。我们由衷荣幸能够共同参与这份面向全世界、见证人类创造力、智慧与纯粹意志力的作品。我们学到了很多，还有很多东西要学，继续为你们所热爱的一切奋斗，保持谦逊。Leonida见。」

paragraphs.en: Perez's role was technically confirmed earlier this week when she was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards. Jason and Lucia have been receiving all kinds of praise for their hyper-detailed relationship, which allows players to roleplay a romantic and nuanced kinship. There hasn't really been anything quite like it in gaming, though that has also led to some annoyance from a certain group of fans who just want a straight-up crime game without the lovey-dovey fluff.
paragraphs.cn: 本周早些时候，Perez获得The Game Awards最佳表演提名，从严格意义上说，她的角色当时就已得到确认。Jason和Lucia之间刻画得极其细致的关系获得了各种赞誉，让玩家得以扮演一段浪漫而微妙的亲密关系。游戏界此前确实没有过与之非常相似的东西，不过这也让某些粉丝感到不满，他们只想要一款纯粹的犯罪游戏，不要那些卿卿我我的东西。

paragraphs.en: Still, there is plenty of crime to be found in this game, obviously. GTA 6's sketchy cast of characters is supported by plenty of new, up-and-coming talent along with some more familiar faces like Bobby Moynihan and Stephen Root ( who leaked his own role earlier this year ). Whether this will catapult Perez and Rourke into more mainstream roles following GTA 6 remains to be seen. GTA 5's Steven Ogg (who played Trevor) was cast in shows like The Walking Dead and Better Call Saul following the game's release. Given GTA 6 is likely going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history, these two actors are about to become some of the most recognizable faces and voices in gaming.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，显然这款游戏里仍然有大量犯罪内容。《GTA6》中那些行迹可疑的角色由众多崭露头角的新人以及一些更为人熟悉的演员共同出演，后者包括鲍比·莫尼汉和斯蒂芬·鲁特（他在今年早些时候泄露了自己的角色）。《GTA6》之后，这是否会让Perez和Rourke迅速获得更多主流角色，还有待观察。《GTA5》发售后，史蒂文·奥格（饰演Trevor）出演了《行尸走肉》和《风骚律师》等剧集。鉴于《GTA6》很可能迎来娱乐史上规模最大的发售，这两位演员即将成为游戏界面孔和声音辨识度最高的演员之一。

If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南——67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或者通过第一章指南与提示和第二章指南与提示，获取开头章节的全部详情。如果你已经驾车走遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和完成的内容，请查看Leonida互动地图。
